Select IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target Mitogen-activated protein kinase 14 (target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL260). Return columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures, INNER JOIN, non-null required), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback docs.doi; non-null required), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL260', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, pubmed_id_or_doi IS NOT NULL. Join path: activities (on assay_id) -> assays -> target_dictionary; activities (on molregno) -> molecule_dictionary; molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures (INNER JOIN); activities (on record_id) -> compound_records; compound_records (on doc_id) -> docs. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
